response.sql: WITH telescope_averages AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse_rate FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), first_baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS rate FROM telescope_averages), first_kept AS (SELECT t.telescref, t.avg_pulse_rate FROM telescope_averages t CROSS JOIN first_baseline b WHERE t.avg_pulse_rate > b.rate), second_baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS rate FROM first_kept) SELECT AVG(k.avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_pulse_rate, AVG(k.avg_pulse_rate - b1.rate) AS mean_above_first_baseline, AVG(k.avg_pulse_rate - b2.rate) AS mean_above_second_baseline FROM first_kept k CROSS JOIN first_baseline b1 CROSS JOIN second_baseline b2 WHERE k.avg_pulse_rate > b2.rate
